description: Unit tests for the absl::strings internal charconv parsing functions, specifically testing float parsing and special value recognition.

methods.name: ExpectParsedFloat
methods.description: Tests parsing of a string into a float, checking type, mantissa, exponent, and subrange.

methods.name: ExpectNumber
methods.description: Tests parsing of a string expected to be a number, verifying mantissa and exponent.

methods.name: ExpectSpecial
methods.description: Tests parsing of special float values like infinity and NaN.

methods.name: ExpectFailedParse
methods.description: Verifies that parsing fails for invalid float strings.
